questDescription->[faction_name] is ready to grant [pawn_definite] the title of [newTitle] in a bestowing ceremony.

The bestower will arrive by shuttle and perform the ceremony.

There's a chance of gaining extra honor, depending on how many viewers attend the ceremony. Additionally, every viewer gains a mood bonus.

If you miss or fail this ceremony, there will be another opportunity later. If the bestower or guards are harmed for any reason, there will be diplomatic consequences.
